title: Clear thorium_repairs.sh and lift the coverage gate's case timeout
objective: Bring thorium_repairs.sh to 100% measured line coverage and remove its allowlist exemption, and stop the gate's 120s per-case timeout from failing libs whose coverage is actually 100%.
acceptance_criteria: The jail reports thorium_repairs.sh at 100.00% through tests/run_all.sh at --min 100, exiting 0.
check_shell_coverage.sh passes on thorium_repairs.sh with its allowlist line already deleted, so the pass cannot come from the exemption.
check_shell_coverage.sh passes on bt_audio.sh, which failed before this change despite measuring 127/127, because the case timed out.
All five profile-repair functions plus test_thorium are covered, including every dry-run arm and the sqlite3-absent path.
thorium_repairs.sh itself is unmodified: it already took every path from $THORIUM_CONFIG_DIR, so no production seam was needed.
The suite stays green and shellcheck reports nothing, with zero suppressions.
out_of_scope: Un-quarantining arch_sysctl_quarantined_cases.sh: re-adding it still breaks bt_audio's measurement even at a 600s timeout, so runtime was not its cause.
The remaining four untested libs: hosts_guard_migrate, hosts_guard_rollback, ubuntu_perf_fixes, nvidia_config.
verifier: timeout 900s bash meta/scripts/shell_coverage_jail.sh --timeout 600s --subject linux_configuration/scripts/single_use/fixes/lib/tests/run_all.sh --measure thorium_repairs.sh --min 100 --fail-on-case-error -- "" (expects 75/75 = 100.00%, exit 0), then bash meta/scripts/check_shell_coverage.sh on thorium_repairs.sh and bt_audio.sh with the allowlist line removed.
